extraction_method: git cat-file blob <commit_sha>:<upstream_path>, byte-exact, no eol/filter conversion; per-file integrity proven by git blob sha1 recomputation (git_blob_sha1) against the pinned commit tree

license.note: LICENSE.asc at the pinned commit: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported. Note the book content itself is AsciiDoc and is not part of the snapshot.
license.redistribution_note: Storage policy MATERIALIZE_ONLY: these bytes must not be publicly vendored by default. They are materialized locally at the pinned commit for verification and characterization and are excluded from public Git storage; expected sha256/bytes/blob-id are recorded here so any local materialization is verifiable.

role_caveat: INTENDED_BOOK_SOURCE_IS_ASCIIDOC: the Pro Git book text (book/*/*.asc) is not Markdown and is not snapshotted; the snapshotted root Markdown is administrative repository material. This candidate must NOT be counted as BOOK_TUTORIAL Markdown workload coverage during the workload-selection stage.
scope_rationale: Scope = root-level repository Markdown only. The intended book source is AsciiDoc (book/*/*.asc) and is deliberately NOT converted, so the book text is outside any Markdown frame by format; see role_caveat.
storage_policy_rationale: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (NonCommercial + ShareAlike) makes public vendoring from this repository uncertain for benchmark use; the policy fails closed (MATERIALIZE_ONLY) and records the uncertainty instead of making a legal claim. The snapshotted root Markdown is administrative repository material, not book text.
